## F1 — A chained fix plan advertises "then review and fix", though a fix plan is never reviewed

The run stops with "the working tree is dirty after the rescue" although the rescue changed nothing. - Should: §7 says the loop takes the head and the dirt before the session and afterwards compares with `touched`; only a change made by the rescue may fail it. Keep the pre-session head and dirt and compare both, as `touched` does.
